author: Kat Mykals
title: One of Indiana's Most Beautiful Summer Events Is Free to Attend - NewsBreak
text:
By Kat Mykals ,
4 hours ago
ColorPlayer There’s something magical about watching a hot air balloon come to life after the sun goes down.
That experience is returning to Madison, Indiana , later this summer as the Madison Regatta Balloon Glow makes its annual return, giving visitors a chance to enjoy an evening of glowing balloons along the Ohio River … for free!
Whether you’re already planning a trip to Madison or looking for a fun excuse for a late- summer road trip, this family-friendly event is worth adding to your calendar.
What Is a Balloon Glow? Unlike a traditional hot air balloon festival where balloons take flight, a balloon glow keeps the balloons tethered to the ground while pilots ignite the burners after dark.
The result is dozens of colorful balloons glowing against the evening sky, creating a picture-perfect backdrop that’s become a favorite annual tradition for Regatta fans and visitors alike.
Read More: Don’t Miss This Massive Hot Air Balloon Festival in Indiana
When and Where The Madison Regatta Balloon Glow takes place:
Sunday, August 23, 2026 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. Riverboat Inn and Suites , located at 906 E. 1st Street, Madison, Indiana Read More: Madison Named Among Best Main Streets in America by Travel & Leisure
Formerly Part of Madison Regatta Weekend The Balloon Glow has formerly been a part of the Madison Regatta Weekend , but in 2025 the event was postponed to a later date due to weather. The 2026 event will take place a few weeks after the Madison Regatta. Tickets for the 2027 Regatta will be available at a discounted price during the 2026 Balloon Glow.
The glow offers a slower-paced evening while giving families another reason to spend time in Madison.
Whether you visit for the boats, the balloons, or just to enjoy one of Indiana’s most charming river towns, the Balloon Glow promises a memorable summer evening.
